keyFindings.description: captureDefaultSlog points the process's default slog at a JSON handler over a bare bytes.Buffer, and decodeRecords (:32) and the credential loop (:101) read it with no lock. Bus clients that earlier tests closed still write through the default: nats.go v1.50.0 close() queues DisconnectedErrCB and ClosedCB on its async dispatcher and returns without waiting (nats.go:5892-5910), and the bus's ClosedCB logs `envoy nats connection closed` (internal/bus/connect.go:126-127). The test's own comment at :79-80 expects such writers. A write that runs during a read is a data race, and envoy-go-race runs ./internal/bus/ under -race (.github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml:971), so the test can fail at random in a lane that every change under packages/envoy runs. Fix: a mutex-guarded writer with a guarded snapshot, as busLogs does in package bus_test (internal/bus/restart_test.go:186-201). TestAConsumerNotActiveReportIsAWarning (internal/bus/async_error_test.go:23-25), which the helper's comment names as its model, captures the log the same way and should use the same helper.
